newsitem.title: UK: Dixon Motors Q1 business ahead of last yr.
newsitem.headline: Dixon Motors Q1 business ahead of last yr.

text.p: Motor retailer Dixon Motors Plc said on Wednesday that trading since the end of the year was "considerably" ahead of last year.

The company told shareholders at its annual general meeting that vehicle units sold in the first quarter of 1997 on a like- for-like basis, excluding the impact of acquisitions and new developments, were 20 percent ahead of the same period in 1996.
"We have made an excellent start to 1997," chairman Donald Driver told shareholders. "All areas of the business are again performing significantly ahead of last year."
The company also said that future earnings and shareholder value would be improved by the award of new and enlarged marketing territories by several of its franchise partners.
By 0940 GMT, shares in Dixon had raced ahead 23p to 316-1/2.
